Nice river view restaurant for meat lovers
Feb 2026 • Couples
The restaurant overlooks the river and there is an outdoor seating area, which is great in the evening as the lantern boats are frequently passing by. 
The staff offer you mosquito repellent once you are seated. However, we assumed that it was antibacterial spray! Fortunately, we weren’t bothered at all by mosquitoes. 
We ordered pork ribs, burger and wedges. The food was well cooked and nicely presented. There was too much food for us and we ended up given the restaurant little dog what was left of the meat. 
The food was reasonably priced, particularly as this is a tourist area. 
On that point, the streets of Hoi An old town were jam packed with tourists and almost every shop, and there’s hundreds of them, are selling either souvenirs or food. 
If you wish to enter the religious sites, you need to purchase tickets from the yellow ticket booths for 120,000 VND (£3-36) when entering the old town area. 
We got return ride taxi from Da Nang. The journey took us about an hour. We were dropped off at the entrance to Old Town and when we wanted to be picked up (about 3 hours later) we just texted the driver and he came and picked us up. All for the sum of 550,000 VND (£15-40)

So good!
Dec 2025 • Couples
The rave reviews for A6 are well deserved. It's off the beaten path, it's along the water down and when following the map, we were wondering if there was even a walkway along the area it sent us, but there is, and well worth the visit. 

About half of the restaurant is under the open sky, and about half of the restaurant is covered. It started to rain on us, and they helped us relocate under cover. It allowed us to see the grill, which I appreciated. 

The place is rustic, nothing fancy about it, but the food is top-notch. We started with the tuna tartare, and this is something we order only if we trust the place and the restaurant gave us that feeling we could trust them, and so glad we did. 

They had it prepped and cooked in front of us, and it was a great way to start off the meal. The brisket and lamb were delicious as well. You have a choice of BBQ to choose from, and each one was delicious. The lamb and beef brisket as nicely cooked, retaining their flavor and moisture with the sauces to round it out. 

The drinks were a nice accompaniment, and we thoroughly enjoyed the meal and would say it was the best meal we had in Hoi An, and for the cost, you hope it is. It's not cheap, but the quality shines through and its money well spent.
